place_fields.vibe: Scenic hill viewpoint and short trekking area
place_fields.summary: Kabbe Betta View is a scenic viewpoint in the Chelavara area of Kodagu, associated with Kabbe Betta/Kabbe Hills and visited for hill views and trekking.

planning_attributes.description: Kabbe Betta View is listed as a nature preserve/tourist attraction near Chelavara in Kodagu, with visitor references describing a short trek to the viewpoint.
planning_attributes.how_to_reach: The viewpoint is on an unnamed road in the Chelavara area; local listings place Kabbe Betta View near Chelavara village.
planning_attributes.safety_notes: The area involves hill/trekking terrain; visitors should use appropriate footwear and exercise normal caution on uneven slopes.

place_fields.summary: The supplied listing corresponds to the Nishani trekking/viewpoint area in Kodagu. The documented Nishani Motte route passes through shola forest, grassland and ridge terrain to a summit with Western Ghats views.

planning_attributes.description: Nishani Motte is a lesser-known Kodagu trek with forest, meadow and ridge sections leading to a summit viewpoint.
planning_attributes.how_to_reach: The Kodagu Eco Tourism trail lists Talacauvery as the starting point and Nishanimotte as the endpoint for the documented Nishani Motte trek.
planning_attributes.access_restrictions: The documented trek is offered through the Kodagu Eco Tourism system; access arrangements should be checked before travel.
planning_attributes.safety_notes: The documented route is a long trek through forest, meadow and ridge terrain; appropriate fitness, footwear and current local guidance are advisable.
planning_attributes.notes: The supplied title is a trekking viewpoint listing rather than an official place-name entry; the available evidence supports association with the Nishani Motte trekking area but does not establish that the supplied coordinates are the summit itself.

place_fields.summary: Mandalpatti is a well-known hill viewpoint in Coorg overlooking the Pushpagiri forest landscape and is especially associated with scenic sunrise and sunset views and jeep rides.

planning_attributes.description: The Kodagu District administration describes Mandalpatti as an adventure destination overlooking the grasslands of Pushpagiri forests and notes its popularity for sunrise and sunset views.
planning_attributes.elevation_or_height: The Kodagu District administration page gives two elevations for Mandalpatti: 1800 metres in one passage and 1600 metres in another; the disagreement is preserved rather than silently resolved.
planning_attributes.how_to_reach: The Kodagu District administration describes Mandalpatti as being about 18 km from Madikeri and notes access through the coffee-estate route; it also identifies jeep riding as a principal visitor activity.
planning_attributes.safety_notes: The destination includes hill terrain and off-road jeep access; visitors should follow current local and Forest Department guidance and use caution on uneven terrain.
